name: resumotion-repo
description: Repo-level scripts: package the skill zip and validate it.

scripts.zip-check: powershell -Command "Add-Type -Assembly System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $z=[IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead('resumotion.zip'); $bad=$z.Entries|Where-Object{$_.FullName -notmatch '^resumotion/'}; if($bad){$bad|ForEach-Object{Write-Host $_.FullName}}else{Write-Host 'all entries start with resumotion/ OK'}; $z.Dispose()"
